q: By what nickname are Derby County known?
hint: The ram is the emblem of the First Regiment of Derby Militia, and appears on the club badge.

q: Derby County won their first English league title in 1972 under which manager?
hint: Clough and his assistant Peter Taylor built the side; Clough left the following year after falling out with the board.

q: Derby County won a second league title in 1975 under which manager?
hint: Mackay had played for the club before taking the job and won the title with much of Clough's side.

q: Which ground did Derby County leave in 1997 after 102 years?
hint: The name came from the site's earlier use for baseball, briefly popular in Victorian England.

q: Derby County's rivalry, the East Midlands derby, is with which club?
hint: Brian Clough managing both clubs, and winning the league with each, gives the fixture an extra edge.

q: Derby County set an unwanted Premier League record in 2007-08. What was it?
o: The fewest points in a season
The most red cards in a season
The fewest goals scored at home
The most managers in a season
hint: They finished with 11 points and one win, a low no club has since matched.

q: Who is Derby County's record goalscorer, and an England star of the early 1900s?
hint: Bloomer scored 332 goals for the club across two spells and is commemorated at Pride Park to this day.

q: Derby County were founded in 1884 as an offshoot of what?
hint: Derbyshire County Cricket Club formed the football side to generate income during the winter months.

q: Derby County won the FA Cup in which year?
hint: It came in the first FA Cup final after the Second World War, a 4-1 win over Charlton Athletic.

q: What is the name of Derby County's home ground?
hint: It opened in 1997 and has also carried sponsored names during its history.

q: What colours do Derby County traditionally wear at home?
hint: The white shirt with black trim has been the club's identity for most of its history.

q: In 2021 Derby County entered administration under which manager?
hint: Rooney kept the squad together through a points deduction, though the club was relegated to League One.

q: Which former England midfielder managed Derby County to the 2019 Championship play-off final?
hint: It was Lampard's first managerial job; Aston Villa won the final and he left for Chelsea that summer.

q: Nigel Clough managed Derby County from 2009, sharing what connection with the club's greatest era?
o: He was captain of the 1972 side
He scored in the 1975 title win
hint: His father won Derby the 1972 title before going on to greater success at their fiercest rivals.

q: Derby County's 1972 league title was unusual because it was confirmed how?
o: While the squad was on holiday abroad
By goal difference on the final day
After a points deduction for a rival
hint: Derby had finished their fixtures and the players were away when results elsewhere handed them the championship.

q: Which competition did Derby County reach the semi-finals of in 1973?
hint: It followed the 1972 league title, and remains the club's deepest European run.
